description.en: Sets the level of a recruited player. The player also learns the techniques of their list that need that level or less, and their GP and TP are refilled to the new maximum.

true once set.
null if the handle is not a valid player, the player data is not available, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A new recruit at level 20 (real usage, from ev42019001.nut)
